name: thyra-onboarding-platform
description: Client registration, login and onboarding for Thyra. React (Vite) frontend and Express with PostgreSQL backend.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
